description:
Rupee dressed up in a Santa Claus costume, which she has done to deliver gifts and spread the Christmas cheer to everyone this winter.
The first white Christmas in 15 years has Rupee incredibly busy.

lines.text: Winter wear is all about fur. This is a fantastic piece... Maybe I should buy the whole lot?
I'll be the one offering the finest outfits this season. Hehe... Am I getting carried away?
Hello~ What's that? The new items look great on me? Why thank you!
You know the perfect activity for cold weather like this? Shopping, of course! Walking around, holding hands... You'll get warmed up in no time.
I'm going with an ice queen vibe for tonight's show. What do you think? Isn't it fabulous?
Have you seen the lights they set up on Royal Road? Aren't they beautiful? Would you be interested in going with me...?
Hey! Don't zone out at a time like this! We've got places to go.
I completely changed up my look for Sweetie! Unfortunately, you seem to have your mind on other things...
This season's new clothing line has just been released! Let's hurry to the shopping mall before the line stretches past the entire block!
Money can't solve everything? Are you sure you don't simply have enough of it? Hehe.
We're doing a seasonal giveaway on the channel, so be sure to tune in.
When it comes to the latest fashions, if you snooze, you lose! Before you know it, they're gone and it's onto the next fad.
Managed to snag a great deal on this upgrade!
The bank account has taken a heavy hit, but it's still worth it. Hehe.
Thanks for all the support! I have some great stuff in store for you.
It's wonderful! Can I record an unboxing video?
It doesn't matter what it is, anything from you is the greatest gift of all.
This will be our brand logo from here on out.
If we sold coupons for one day with you, I'd buy every last one of them.
The latest seasonal outfits may be limited, but my love for you is unlimited!
So... are we official now?
Shopaholic on the move!
Rupee-ru, la lee loo ☆
... Can I hold hands with you?
Some cold hard cash should solve this problem.
Let's hurry up and go buy the latest items!
Are we sure this can't be solved with money?
Don't underestimate the power of a shopaholic.
Hang on!
How's my gun decal look?
Come on!
Time's up!
Let's go take care of business, just the two of us.
Preparation complete! Why save, when you can spend!
Woohoo!
Oh yeah!
Hehe.
Ouch!
That hurt!
No!
Looks like we didn't invest enough cash flow into this problem.
Shopaholics always end up on top! Actually, this would make a killer livestream...
